routeHint: Administration sidebar -> Email logs. Requires an ADMIN_TENANT account.
alt: Email logs list with a recipient search box and a table of ID, sent date, member, subject and type
notes: Entry 4447's subject carried a name belonging to nobody on this tenant and is now the recipient's own. The Type column is only chipped for the types EmailLog/List.vue emailTypeMeta maps (welcome, fee reminders, subscription renewals, transactional_email, newsletter, admin_notification); system mail such as task_assigned or registration is stored with its own type and renders no chip, so most rows are blank by design.

routeHint: Administration -> Email logs -> click the ID link of the first row. Navigating by URL to /email-log/<id> works too, but opening the row from the list is what the page describes. The newest t187c row is entry 4500, a newsletter send with a stored HTML body: type 'newsletter' is one of the types the Type card actually chips, so all four cards are populated.
alt: Email log entry showing recipient, subject, sent date and type cards above a rendered preview of the email body
notes: Recaptured 2026-08-06. The Sent date card used to read item.dateSent, which the API did not expose, so moment(undefined) printed today's date on every entry; it now prints the row's own date (Aug 5, 2026 for entry 4500). Keep the row's date and the list screenshot on the same page consistent.
